results.title: Businesses see no near-term shift in US trade stance on Vietnam after midterms, amid record surplus | Durham Herald Sun
results.snippet:
Vietnam has overtaken China and Mexico to become the country with the largest goods trade surplus with the United States, according to US trade data released on Wednesday, thanks to a variety of exports, including electronic goods, apparel, footwear and wood products.

In the first nine months of the year, Vietnam's record surplus reached nearly $190 billion, about 47% higher than a year earlier.
